title: parasenecio vespertilio
intro: Parasenecio vespertilio, commonly known as the bat's wing plant, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Parasenecio vespertilio include its ability to promote relaxation and improve sleep quality. Bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
